title: Readymade Board
description: A Readymade board document: ordered runtimes, ordered service pipelines, and optional facade, assets, blocks and units.

description.description: A short description of what the board does.

runtimes.description: Ordered array of execution environments. Order is the chain.

services.description: Map from runtime id to that runtime's ordered service pipeline.

facade.description: App-like interface of controls and displays over the board.

assets.description: Content declared once in the board and referenced from service state as `hkp-asset://<id>`.

blocks.description: Reusable service definitions referenced in pipelines by `{ "block": "<id>" }`.

unit.description: What this board imports and exports when used as a unit.

units.description: Units this composition board is assembled from.

registry.description: Cached service registry metadata reported by runtimes.

id.description: Unique identifier of this runtime on the board, referenced by the services map.

url.description: Direct URL of a remote runtime server (mutually exclusive with `remote`).

remote.description: Logical name of a remote runtime server resolved by the host client (mutually exclusive with `url`).

color.description: Display accent colour for this runtime.

bundles.description: Optional plugin libraries loaded by the runtime.

uuid.description: Unique identifier of this service instance within its runtime.

Iterator (browser, node, python, cpp): Runs a nested pipeline once per item. Iteration you can see in the board.

Join (node, python): Splits off a piece of work and gets the answer back **beside** what you already
had, rather than instead of it.
Limit (browser): Truncates an array to at most `n` elements.
Local Storage (browser): Reads key–value pairs from the browser's `localStorage` and emits them as an array.
Looper (browser): Records a sequence of pipeline values and replays them at the original timing.
LZ Compress (browser): Compresses or decompresses values using LZ-string — a URL-safe lossless text compression algorithm.
Map (browser, cpp, node, python): Transforms pipeline data by applying a declarative template to produce a new JSON object.

Match Filter (browser): Drops string values that contain any of the configured filter terms, passing all others through.

Monitor (browser, cpp): Displays the current pipeline value in a scrolling log; passes data through unchanged.
Monitor (browser, cpp): Displays the current pipeline value in a scrolling log; passes data through unchanged.
Ollama (browser): Sends a prompt to a local Ollama instance and streams the generated response into the pipeline.
OpenAI Prompt (browser): Sends pipeline data to the OpenAI API and emits the model's response.
Output (browser): Sends the current pipeline value to a remote endpoint via HTTP POST or WebSocket.
Peer Socket (browser): Establishes a named peer-to-peer WebSocket connection for sending or receiving pipeline data between boards or runtimes.
QR Code (browser): Displays a QR code for a URL, updating dynamically when new URLs arrive in the pipeline.
Queue (node): How one board says something to another.
Reduce (browser): Folds a stream of pipeline values into a single accumulated result using a user-defined reducer expression.
RSS (node): Several syndication feeds read as one list, newest first.
Select (browser): Picks a single element from an array by zero-based index.
Sign (browser): Computes an HMAC signature of any pipeline value using the Web Crypto API.
Skill Router (python): Matches free-form text — e.g. a voice transcript — against a configured set of skills with a local LLM and dispatches the matched skill's board with extracted parameters.
Smooth (browser): Applies an exponential moving average (EMA) to numeric pipeline values to reduce noise and sharp transitions.
SMTP Email (node): Sends mail. Addressed by its configuration, or by whatever the pass is carrying.
Sort (browser): Sorts an array of objects by a named property in ascending or descending order.
Sound (browser): Synthesises audio from note events using the Web Audio API, with synth and drum modes.
Speech Synth (browser): Speaks a text string aloud using the browser's Web Speech Synthesis API.
Speech To Text (python, cpp): Transcribes spoken audio to text with a local open-source Whisper model — in the Python runtime via faster-whisper, or in the C++ runtime via embedded sherpa-onnx.
Spotify (browser): Reads playback state and track metadata from the Spotify Web API.
Spread (browser, node, python): Sends each item of an array on by itself — one value in, as many out as it has items.
SQL (node, browser): A board's own SQL database. Tables, columns and meaning all belong to the board.
State (browser): Maintains a configurable key–value store and expands macro templates against incoming data.
Static (cpp): Emits a fixed JSON value on every pipeline tick, regardless of the incoming data.
Stopper (browser, node, python, cpp): Unconditionally stops the pipeline by returning `null` on every tick.

Storage (node): A place on the board where a board keeps bytes — audio it rendered, a file

Store (node): What a board remembers between runs — keyed, durable, and scoped to the board.

Switch (browser): Routes its input into the first of several sub-pipelines whose condition holds: the structured if/else of a board.
Telegram Listener (node): Listens for incoming Telegram messages via a bot and pushes each text message into the pipeline.
Text Generation (python, cpp, node): Generates text with a large language model — a local one via an OpenAI-compatible server or in-process, or a hosted one.
Text To Speech (python, cpp): Synthesizes speech from text with a local open-source model — Kokoro, running in the Python runtime via kokoro-onnx or in the C++ runtime via embedded sherpa-onnx.

Timeline (browser): Time as a value: an object animated through keyframes, and actions fired when

Timer (browser, node, python, cpp): Generates periodic or one-shot timing events to drive pipeline execution.
Timer (browser, node, python, cpp): Generates periodic or one-shot timing events to drive pipeline execution.
Tracks (browser, node, python, cpp): Several pipelines over one input, and one answer out.
Trigger Pad (browser): A grid of assignable buttons; pressing a pad sends its configured payload into the pipeline.
UUID Generator (browser): Generates a UUID on every pipeline tick and emits it or merges it into the incoming object.
WAV Reader (cpp): Reads a WAV audio file from disk and emits its samples as a float array.

periodic.description: When true, the timer fires repeatedly at the configured interval. When false, fires once.

periodicValue.description: Numeric amount for the repeating interval. Interpreted in periodicUnit.

immediate.description: When true, fires one tick immediately (after ~1 ms) in addition to the normal schedule.

counter.description: Overrides the internal trigger counter to a specific value.

running.description: Setting to false stops the timer. Setting to true starts it if start is not otherwise specified.

triggerCount.description: Automatically stops the timer after this many triggers have fired.
